subject: Which scripts do I include in the <head> section of my html file?

messages.author: d30272938537779c
messages.subject: Which scripts do I include in the <head> section of my html file?
parts:
I'm creating my first shiny app with an html ui as described here http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/html-ui.html. I want to use renderDataTable in my app but think I need to include some new scripts in my index.html file. Here is a list of what I currently have in there:

<link href="http://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/3.3.5/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="shared/jquery.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
<script src="shared/shiny.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
<script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/1.11.3/jquery.min.js"></script>
<script src="http://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/3.3.5/js/bootstrap.min.js"></script>

Can anyone help me out? I'm assuming I need to link to a DataTables script?

Thanks,
Gene
